source_pages: Prospectus p.29; Prospectus p.27; SPO p.5
evidence_zh: 对照《绿色金融支持项目目录（2025年版）》，募投项目属于“8.绿色贸易-8.5 新能源与清洁能源装备贸易-8.5.1 风力发电装备贸易（5179 其他机械设备及电子产品批发）”。 / 本期债券募集资金符合于《工业战略性新兴产业分类目录(2023)》中“风能发电机装备及零部件制造”领域
rationale: Category is named in the 2025 catalogue, but as equipment TRADE (wholesale code 5179), while chapter 4 of the same prospectus describes the use as MANUFACTURING of wind turbine equipment and components. Goldwind is a manufacturer, so the label is inconsistent across sections.

evidence_zh: 具体用于金风科技向上游供应商采购风电机组大部件及零配件，包括发电机、叶片、轮毂、齿轮箱、变流器等 / 对应的风力发电机组采购容量约为 677.13MW
rationale: One defined activity (component procurement) with an estimated scale of about 677 MW, but no project list, no supplier list and no amounts per purchase.

evidence_zh: 本期绿色科技创新债券募集资金预计每年可实现减排 CO2（当量）36.03 万吨，节能量（替代标煤量）14.57 万吨，减排 SO2 37.17 吨，减排 NOx 60.34 吨，减排颗粒物 5.79 吨。
rationale: CO2 and other pollutants are quantified with disclosed formulas and emission factors. The figures are attributed pro rata (proceeds / downstream wind-farm investment); the headline for the full 677 MW is 100.03 万吨 CO2.

evidence_zh: 金风科技制造组装成整机后全部出售给下游风力发电场投资开发商，以支持风力发电项目建设。
rationale: Proceeds buy components that Goldwind assembles into turbines and sells to third-party wind-farm developers. The environmental benefit arises downstream at assets Goldwind does not own, so the link is indirect.

evidence_zh: 在绿色债务融资工具存续期间内，募集资金全部用于绿色项目（含绿色有息债务）
rationale: Refinancing of green interest-bearing debt is permitted with no cap. No refinancing share and no look-back period are disclosed in the prospectus.

evidence_zh: 联合赤道认证团队审核了金风科技本期绿色科技创新债券相关的发行人内部控制文件，包括《集团采购管理制度》《集团采购合同管理办法》等。 / 在项目筛选和决策程序上，金风科技建立了较为完善的控制体系，根据《绿色金融支持项目目录（2025年版）》对项目进行初选
rationale: The process exists only at policy level. The documents the reviewer examined are procurement rules, not green-selection rules. The decision-making body and exclusion criteria are not disclosed.

evidence_zh: 综上分析，在采取相应风险防范措施的情况下，募投项目总体环境和社会风险较小。
rationale: Prospectus risks are generic wind-farm risks (construction, safety, shortfall of environmental benefit). The SPO lists issuer-level mitigation (waste, packaging and blade recycling), nothing specific to the purchased components. SPO read visually, not fully.

evidence_zh: 项目评估筛选流程严谨，项目合规性文件齐全，金风科技在项目评估与筛选方面表现优秀。
rationale: Screening against the 2025 catalogue and the compliance documents was reviewed by an external reviewer. Caveat: for this series the compliance documents reviewed are procurement policies, not project approvals.

evidence_zh: 发行人已与招商银行股份有限公司乌鲁木齐分行签订募集资金监管协议，对募集资金采取专户监管模式，确保募集资金的合理有效使用。
rationale: Dedicated account under a bank supervision agreement; account details are disclosed.

evidence_zh: 发行人集团财务中心负责本期债券募集资金的总体调度和安排，对募集资金支付情况建立详细的账务管理并及时做好相关会计记录，且将不定期对募集资金使用情况进行现场检查核实
rationale: Named owner plus a verification procedure. Checks are ad hoc (不定期), not scheduled, and there is no external audit of allocation.

source_pages: Prospectus (full-text search); SPO PDF pages 12 and 15 not opened
rationale: No rule on temporary placement of unallocated proceeds found in the prospectus (full-text search for 闲置 and 暂时 found nothing relevant). The scanned SPO was read visually except two PDF pages.

evidence_zh: 债券存续期内，发行人每年 4 月 30 日、8 月 31 日前分别披露上一年度和上半年绿债相关信息。上半年披露应包括募集资金使用情况、已投绿色项目数量及进展、未使用资金、募集资金管理等内容。
rationale: Commitment with frequency (annual by 30 April, half-year by 31 August) and content (use, unused funds, project progress).

evidence_zh: 年度披露应参照《绿色债券存续期信息披露指南》中定期报告模板、环境效益信息披露指标等相关要求进行披露。
rationale: Commits to quantitative environmental indicators under a reference framework. Not yet testable: no post-issuance report exists, and the pro-rata attribution basis will presumably carry over.

evidence_zh: 认定本期绿色科技创新债券符合上述标准要求，募集资金全部用于绿色产业领域，绿色等级为 G1 / 本次评估结果自本期债券发行之日起生效，有效期为一年。
rationale: Pre-issuance independent assessment only (联合赤道, grade G1). No commitment to post-issuance verification found; the assessment is valid for one year from the issue date.
